market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $130 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI $130 HIGH by end of June from current $108. Need +$22 in 2 months. With Iran/Strait of Hormuz tensions actively elevated and Trump considering military action, this is plausible but requires further escalation. Base case absent action: doesn't reach. With escalation: easily passes. Probability reflects ~30-40% conditional on continued tensions.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether US-Iran conflict actually materializes vs. saber-rattling that fades.
